page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries. Left column: entries א ׳ (Aleph-yod), beginning with a continuing fragment. Right column: heading "א כ" at the top, then entries under it. Running heads at top left and top right, page number "18" at top left. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: ubinam, אֵיפוֹ jam, &c. particulæ à part. Rad. הֵא hic.
וָאִיקָץ & evigilavi, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. יקץ.
אִירָא timebo, אִירָאֵנִי timebo eum, 1. sing. fut. Kal, aff. Rad. יָרָא.
אִירְשֶׁנָּה possidebo eam, 1. f. fut. Kal, aff. R. יָרַשׁ.
אִישׁוֹן nigrum, nigredo, &c. No. sing. m. R. אִישׁ vir, mas.
אִישָּׁנָה dormiam, 1. singul. futur. Kal, parag. Rad. יָשַׁן.
אִישַּׁר æquabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, R. יָשַׁר.
אִתּוֹן ingressus, No. sing. masc. Rad. אָתָה venit.
אִיתָּם integer ero, 1. sing. fut. Niph. Rad. תָּמַם.
אֵיתָן fortis, robur suum, יִם robusti, &c. No. sing. masc. affix. & pl. masc. Rad. אִית [?].
main_text.head: א כ
main_text.p: נְאַךְ & percussi, אַכָּה percutiam, אַכָּה percutiam te, נִי percutiam eum &c. 1. s. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. נָכָה.
אֶכְבֹּד honorabor, וְאֶכְבַּד & honorabor, Hag. 1. 8. (pro אֶכְבְּדָה) 1. f. fut. Niph. parag. R. כָּבַד.
אַכְזָב fallax, No. sing. masc. R. כָּזַב mentiri.
אַכְזֵב mentiar, 1. sing. fut. Piel, R. כָּזַב.
אַכְזָר crudelis, No. sing. m. Rad. כזר.
אַכְחַד celabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, R. כָּחַד.
אֲכִין ה præparabo, stabiliam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. כּוֹן.
אָכֵל cibus, esca, אָכְלוֹ cibus ejus, &c. No. sing. masc. affix. Rad. אָכַל comedit.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the dense lexicon lines are hard to read at this resolution; uncertain forms are marked [?]. The first Hebrew word of the right column and the last Hebrew entry (אֲכִיל) are doubtful. The running heads are read as the Hebrew letter pairs over each column. The "א כ" line above the right column entries is treated as a heading.
